text.title: PR Pattern Mining For Feedback Worked Examples
text.summary: One complete team-scoped report mined from 64 merged PRs and 412 review comments across two billing repositories (three top patterns with a lint rule, a PR-template checkbox and a query-count CI check; 38 import-order comments collapsed into one ruff change), with a note on every non-obvious value, and one bad report (nine PRs, trait phrasing, import order as a top pattern, a guideline still active after three cycles, an author leaderboard) showing what the validator and the owner reject.

section.title: Scenario
section.p: The billing team wants a quarterly feedback report from Q2 2026 reviews on `acme/billing-api` and `acme/billing-worker`. Four reviewers were active. The most frequent comments are about import order, which `ruff` could enforce; the comments that cost review rounds are missing HTTP timeouts, status-code-only tests and N+1 queries. No previous report exists for this scope.

example.title: Billing team, Q2 2026
example.note: The corpus line carries the GraphQL query verbatim so Q3's report can re-run it; 64 PRs and 412 comments clear the 20 / 100 gate, so rules may be suggested (r-corpus-window-and-query-stated).

The 38 import-order and quote comments were the most frequent thing reviewers wrote, and they appear exactly once, as an `automation_gap` naming the two ruff rule codes; they are in no pattern count (r-formatter-covered-comments-excluded).

`p3` has only 2 distinct reviewers and 5 PRs, which is the minimum; the retry-jitter comment appeared once and stays in `single_occurrence` with its URL rather than becoming a rule (r-pattern-requires-recurrence).

`cost` is mean review round-trips until the comment was resolved, so `p3` (6 comments, 2.5 rounds each) outranks nothing but sits close to `p2` (9 comments, 1.8 rounds); on raw count the order would differ, and the report says which basis it used (r-ranked-by-frequency-times-cost).
Each behaviour is code, with a before and after lifted from a cited comment; "careless about timeouts" would have been rejected (r-pattern-phrased-as-code-behaviour).

Channels descend the preference order with reasons: `p1` gets a lint id, `p3` a CI query-count assertion because no static rule can see serializer access, `p2` a template checkbox because neither a linter nor CI can judge assertion sufficiency. The ADR-link observation has no channel yet, so it is a note (r-suggested-rule-names-enforcement-channel).

Baselines equal this quarter's counts with a 2026-09-30 re-measure; there is no `delta_vs_previous` because no previous report exists. Team scope, no per-author counts; the engineering manager checks the URLs before it circulates (r-baseline-and-remeasure-per-pattern, r-per-person-scope-declared-and-consented, human checkpoint).

example.title: What the validator and the owner reject
example.note: Validator output: `$.scope.per_author_counts_listed: must equal False, got True`, `$.corpus.merged_prs: 9 violates minimum=20`, `$.corpus.review_comments: 41 violates minimum=100`, `$.top_patterns[0].behaviour: 'Authors are careless about error handling' does not match pattern ...`, `$.top_patterns[0].before_example: length 3 below minLength=5`, `$.top_patterns[0].after_example: length 3 below minLength=5`, `$.top_patterns[0].distinct_prs: 2 violates minimum=3`, `$.top_patterns[0].comment_urls: 1 items, minItems=3`, `$.top_patterns[0].count: 2 violates minimum=3`, `$.top_patterns[0]: matches none of anyOf`, `$.top_patterns[1].formatter_coverable: must equal False, got True`, `$.suggested_rules[0].why_not_earlier_channels: missing required field`, `$.suggested_rules[0].status: 'active' not in enum ['ineffective', 'withdrawn']`, `$.review.shared_by_agent: must equal False, got True`, `$.review.owner: missing required field`, `$.review.owner_checked_urls_and_scope_on: missing required field`.

What the owner sees beyond the validator: "looked through recent PRs" is not a query anyone can re-run, so next quarter cannot show a delta (r-corpus-window-and-query-stated); `n/a` examples mean the pattern cannot be grepped for or taught (r-pattern-phrased-as-code-behaviour); 38 formatter comments counted as a pattern with `automation_gap` at zero means one ruff line would have deleted the top of the list (r-formatter-covered-comments-excluded).
